name: @deepseek-harness/dsh-doctor-plugin
description: Meta-plugin: witnesses the official DeepSeek Harness Node runtime. Everything is a plugin — including the doctor. Shells out to `dsh doctor --node` (Python) for the actual probes.
author: Henry Zhang

dsh.notes: Reversal of concern: the official runtime says 'everything is a plugin'; this plugin's job is to audit the runtime that hosts it.
